home.welcome_title: Welcome to the Mengding Tea Digital Museum
home.welcome_desc: Mengding Mountain, the birthplace of world tea culture. For over two thousand years since the Western Han Dynasty, this land has nurtured the oldest tea culture heritage. Here, you will journey through history, experience the millennium charm of tea, and explore the magical transformation from a green leaf to a fragrant cup.
home.featured_desc: One of China's oldest famous teas, originating from the Western Han Dynasty. Tightly curled with silvery tips, jade-green liquor, fresh and sweet taste — known as 'Nectar from Heaven'.

history.intro_p1: The history of Mengding tea is a condensed history of Chinese tea culture. From 53 BC, when tea ancestor Wu Lizhen planted the first tea trees among the five peaks of Mengding Mountain, this land has been inseparable from tea.
history.intro_p2: Through the Western and Eastern Han, Three Kingdoms, and Southern and Northern Dynasties, tea cultivation techniques on Mengding Mountain continued to improve. By the Tang Dynasty (742 AD), Mengding tea was designated as imperial tribute tea, beginning a thousand-year legacy.
history.intro_p3: Tea culture flourished during the Song Dynasty, and Mengding tea was highly regarded by scholars and literati. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, tea-making techniques further developed. Today, the traditional craftsmanship of Mengding tea is recognized as National Intangible Cultural Heritage.

timeline.title: Tea Planted

figures.name: Wu Lizhen
figures.title: Tea Ancestor · Western Han
figures.desc: First cultivated tea trees on Mengding Mountain in 53 BC, honored as the 'Tea Ancestor' who pioneered artificial tea cultivation worldwide.

figures.name: Bai Juyi
figures.title: Tang Dynasty Poet
figures.desc: Great poet of the Tang Dynasty who praised Mengding tea in his poetry: 'Only clear waters in music, only Meng tea among teas'.

figures.name: Lu Yu
figures.title: Tea Sage · Tang Dynasty
figures.desc: Authored 'The Classic of Tea' (Cha Jing), which repeatedly praises Mengding tea as among the finest, contributing greatly to its fame.

list.name: Mengding Ganlu
list.desc: Curled green tea with silvery tips, jade-green liquor, fresh and sweet taste
list.detail: Mengding Ganlu is one of China's oldest famous teas, dating back to the Western Han Dynasty. Its tightly curled shape with abundant downy tips presents a glossy jade-green color. The aroma is rich and fresh, the liquor clear with a slight yellow tint, and the taste is brisk with a lasting sweet aftertaste.

list.name: Mengding Huangya
list.desc: A treasure among yellow teas, tender buds, bright yellow liquor, sweet and mellow
list.detail: Mengding Huangya represents the finest of Chinese yellow tea. Its flat and straight shape with a slight yellow hue reveals tender buds. The liquor is bright yellow with a sweet fragrance, the taste mellow and fresh. The unique yellowing process is key to its distinctive character.

list.name: Mengding Shihua
list.desc: Flat green tea shaped like petals, delicate aroma, lingering finish
list.detail: Mengding Shihua has a flat, smooth shape resembling flower petals with an emerald-green color. When brewed, the liquor is clear and bright with a lasting delicate aroma. Its name derives from its appearance, which resembles flowers blooming among mountain rocks.

list.name: Mengding Jasmine
list.desc: Scented with jasmine, rich floral aroma, brisk tea taste, refreshing
list.detail: Made from high-quality Mengding green tea and fine jasmine blossoms picked in midsummer, undergoing multiple scentings. It combines the brisk character of Mengding green tea with the rich fragrance of jasmine.

list.name: Mengding Jin Jun Mei
list.desc: Premium black tea, honey fragrance, bright red liquor, full-bodied taste
list.detail: Made from tender buds of high-mountain tea gardens, processed through withering, rolling, fermentation, and drying. Features a honey fragrance with fruity and floral notes, bright red liquor, and a full-bodied sweet taste.

list.name: Mengding Maofeng
list.desc: Tightly twisted strands, white tips visible, clear liquor, fresh and mellow
list.detail: A premium green tea with tightly twisted uniform strands, prominent white downy tips, and emerald-green color. The aroma is high and lasting, the liquor clear and bright, the taste fresh and mellow with a sweet aftertaste.

tools.name: Bamboo Tea Sieve
tools.desc: Hand-woven bamboo tool for grading and sifting tea leaves, embodying traditional tea-making wisdom

tools.name: Iron Fixation Pan

tools.name: Bamboo Roasting Basket
tools.desc: Traditional bamboo basket for roasting and shaping tea leaves, ensuring thorough drying

tools.name: Zisha Teapot
tools.desc: Yixing purple clay teapot, ideal for brewing tea, fully releasing the aroma and flavor of tea leaves

craft.banner_sub: The Art of Tea Making · Intangible Heritage
craft.intro_desc: In 2020, the traditional craftsmanship of Mengding tea was inscribed on China's National Intangible Cultural Heritage list. This craft, passed down for over two thousand years, embodies the wisdom and dedication of countless tea artisans.

steps.title: Leaf Picking
steps.desc: On fine weather days, hand-pick tender tea buds with one leaf and one bud, ensuring uniformity and freedom from pests.

steps.title: Withering
steps.desc: Spread fresh leaves thinly on bamboo trays in a cool, ventilated area to allow moderate moisture loss, softening the leaves for subsequent processing.

steps.title: Fixation
steps.desc: Quickly stir-fry leaves in a high-temperature iron pan to deactivate oxidizing enzymes, preserving the green color and releasing tea aroma.

steps.title: Rolling & Roasting
steps.desc: Alternate rolling and roasting to break leaf cells, release juices, shape the leaves tightly, and promote internal transformation.

steps.title: Shaping & Drying
steps.desc: Shape the tea and dry slowly at low temperature to reduce moisture below 5%, fixing quality for long-term preservation.

steps.title: Sorting & Packing
steps.desc: Fine-sort the finished tea, remove impurities and dust, grade by quality, and package to ensure the quality of every cup.

craft.heritage_desc: The legacy of traditional Mengding tea craftsmanship is carried forward by generations of tea artisans who have dedicated their lives to preserving and innovating this precious cultural heritage.
